name: Shi Yueling
bio: Shi Yueling, alias Shi Chunling is an actress from Mainland China. She is a native of Yinchuan in Ningxia and graduated from the 1995 performance department of the Central Academy of Drama. She worked in the Central Experimental Theater (now the National Theater of China) after graduation.

credits.title: There Will Be Snow
credits.overview: As Fireworks, an intelligent urban system, transforms everyday life, a dance teacher from the fading city of Glaceterre is invited to the smart region just as a disillusioned engineer returns. Amid demolition and memories of ice and flame, she must choose between efficiency and human connection—and decide what it means

credits.title: Trending Topic
credits.overview: Chen Miao, an editor in chief of a grassroots journalism platform, encountered a series of follow-up events after publishing a popular article.

credits.title: Summer of Changsha
credits.overview: A detective investigating a bizarre murder case begins to fall in love with a surgeon he has met while trying to solve the crime.
